Giannis scores 30 as Miami holds off Utah

Final · Tue, Nov 10 · Utah

Giannis Antetokounmpo had 30 points and 11 rebounds. Utah’s fourth-quarter run fell short.

1 · First half

How it started.

The Heat led 29–25 after one quarter. At the half, the Heat led 64–54.

2 · The difference

Giannis: 30 points and 11 rebounds

12 of 21 from the floor, in 31 minutes.

3 · How it turned

Up 10 at the half, and up as many as 23 in the third

Giannis and Mitchell combined for 49 of 115.

4 · Where it was won

Won it at the line and on turnovers

Turnovers forced 18–8; free throws made 33–14. Miami scored 25 points off 18 Utah turnovers.
